name: Sana Starros' SE-14r light repeating blaster
wookieepedia_title: Sana Starros' SE-14r light repeating blaster
description: A SE-14r light repeating blaster was owned by the smuggler Sana Starros during the Imperial Era. The blaster pistol had no scope to facilitate Starros drawing the blaster faster.
